GitHub main → Railway builds the Docker image (Python 3.12, uv, LibreOffice) on every push → https://course-assistant-production-3fbf.up.railway.app. Local development runs the same app on a laptop (uv run course-assistant) with
its own data/ folder and a read-only library. API settings come from .env (never committed).
